title: Pale Oak
summary: Druid reward that grants Faithwarden’s Vines and protection against ordinary druidic vines.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d6 Bludgeoning one-handed or 1d8 two-handed, plus Strength. Simple Versatile weapon, 5 ft reach, Dippable.
fields.Faithwarden’s Vines: Level 1, Action, 60 ft range, once per Long Rest. Creates a 10 ft radius of vines for up to 10 turns with Concentration. The terrain halves movement. DC 12 Strength prevents Entangled for 1 turn. An entangled target cannot move, has disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity saves, and grants advantage to attackers. Help removes Entangled and Fire burns away the vines.
fields.Faithwarden’s Stride: Druidic vines cannot Entangle you or slow you as Difficult Terrain: Vines. It does not bypass other difficult terrain or Jaheira’s scripted cutscene. The staff unlocks a Faithwarden dialogue option with Jaheira.
fields.Topple: Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. Melee attack for 1d4 nonlethal Bludgeoning. Dexterity save against weapon-action DC +2 or Prone for 1 turn.
fields.Acquisition: Before finishing Rescue the Druid Halsin, have a Druid first speak to Kagha or Rath after dealing with the Shadow Druids during Investigate Kagha. Swayed Kagha gives it, or Rath if she dies.
fields.Base value: 600 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
